patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, often pairing large text blocks with product imagery or abstract visuals, creating dynamic visual balance.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact and clear hierarchy, contrasted with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, maintaining readability and a modern feel.
A deep, rich forest green is used as a primary brand color for hero and footer sections, providing a strong, sophisticated anchor against light off-white content areas.

The hero section features a sticky headline and background that remains in view for a significant portion of the scroll, while product cards and other elements scroll up and out from underneath, creating a layered reveal effect.
Product display sections feature a clean grid of distinct product cards, each with an image, title, and a clear call to action, presented against a contrasting background.

technique_notes: To achieve the layered scroll effect, the main hero headline and its dark background are set to a fixed or sticky position for a portion of the scroll, allowing other elements like product cards to scroll underneath and out of view. Sections below the hero then scroll normally, often with a distinct background color change. The 'swiper' tech hint suggests product carousels might be present on other pages or states, but the observed motion is primarily scroll-triggered.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and product cards, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic without being overly soft.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around text blocks and images, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site stands out with its bold, deep forest green branding, which is consistently applied to key sections like the hero and footer, creating a strong, sophisticated identity. The distinctive sticky hero text that overlays scrolling content adds a dynamic and engaging visual layer.
